entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thanks for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... um, I'm calling because I need to return something. It's my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order here, delivered on December 15th, so you've had it for 22 days. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
(Sighs) It's just a preference, I guess. To be honest, it was an impulse buy. I really thought I'd get into cycling more, but I just don't use it. I've completely changed my mind about needing it.
I see. So it's working fine, you've just decided against keeping it?

Yes. And I feel so bad about it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a while now, but I could really use the money back. I even looked into the online resale market, but I wouldn't get back what I paid. I was hoping you could help.
I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just check our current return policy for you. Please hold one moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've just reviewed the policy, and you're all set. Our standard return window is 90 days.
Oh, really? I was so worried I had missed the deadline! Are you sure?

Absolutely. Since you're only on day 22, you are well within the timeframe. I've gone ahead and authorized the return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. Just place the item back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
(Voice brightens) Wow. Diana, that is such a relief. Thank you, thank you so much! You have no idea how much this helps me.
You are very welcome. I'm happy I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. You've been wonderful. Thanks again!
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
